label: product launch qa process: Receive and validate inbound materials — Verify that raw materials and components from suppliers meet quality standards and inventory requirements before production.

trace.picked_reason: Material Receipt Inbound API directly supports receiving and validating inbound materials with integrated quality inspection workflows. It provides capabilities for validate-material, verify-compliance, validate-shipment, and assess-inventory-requirements. Exposes Material and Vendor entity types, and operates in Procurement/Inventory Management/Manufacturing domains—perfectly aligned with QA process for verifying raw materials and components meet quality standards and inventory requirements before production.
